code_hints: Before waiting for PLP, query and click the OneTrust accept button if present: document.querySelector('#onetrust-accept-btn-handler')?.click(); then wait 300-500ms.
After navigation, wait for any of the PLP grid selectors; if none appear in 5s, perform lazy scroll (6 steps, 600ms delay) and re-check.
If a Load more button (selectors.load_more) is visible, click until it disappears or no new tiles are added.
When extracting product links from PLP, restrict to anchors ending with .html and containing '/en-'.
If redirected to a different locale (path starts with /en- but not /en-de/), rewrite to /en-de/ + remainder and retry once.
Use the PDP wait_for selectors before reading title/price; prices often live in [itemprop='price'] or .product-price .value.
rationale: Moncler commonly shows a OneTrust cookie banner that blocks PLP data from loading; clicking the accept button resolves this. The PLP appears to lazy-load; adding robust grid/tile selectors, lazy scrolling, and load-more handling increases stability. Locale redirects can swap /en-de/ to another locale; normalizing back to /en-de/ avoids URL traps. PDP selectors focus on semantic attributes used across SFCC/Next-based builds (itemprop, data-test).
